chunks: What Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abū ʿUbaydah al-Ḥadhdhāʾ, who said:
I saw Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام pronouncing the takbīr one by one, so I said to him: “Why do you pronounce the takbīr one by one?” He said: “There is no harm in it when you are in haste in the adhan.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or legal objection
key_terms.مُسْتَعْجِلًا: being in haste or pressed for time
key_terms.يُكَبِّرُ: he pronounces the takbīr in the adhan

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite the takbīrs of the adhan one by one when in a hurry?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام recited the takbīrs of the adhan singly, and when asked about it, he permitted doing so in a state of haste. The narration indicates a legal allowance concerning the manner of pronouncing the adhan when one is pressed for time.
